notes: Release date: kimi.ai official blog index lists 'Kimi K2 | 2025-07-11'; HuggingFace moonshotai/Kimi-K2-Instruct createdAt 2025-07-11T00:55:12Z agrees. Page banner notes Update(0905): an updated weight with enhanced agentic coding and 256K context followed on 2025-09-05 (tracked as baseline column 'K2 0905' inside kimi-k2-thinking.json, not a separate file). The benchmark section is a single machine-readable DOM table (Playwright extraction), so all 32 rows are verified; no global sampling-parameter footnote is printed on the page - aggregation per row comes from the table's Intro column (Pass@1 / Acc / Avg@4/8/16/32/64 / EM / Prompt Strict / Correct). Asterisks on some competitor cells have no printed footnote on this page; semantics unverified, so those cells stay in notes. Benchmark table columns (order): Kimi-K2-Instruct | DeepSeek-V3-0324 | Qwen3-235B-A22B (Non-thinking) | Claude Sonnet 4 (w/o extended thinking) | Claude Opus 4 (w/o extended thinking) | GPT-4.1 | Gemini 2.5 Flash Preview (05-20).
